messages:
ben: Heads-up — planning a v2 rollforward tonight in the quiet window (00:30-02:30 UTC). Targeting 30% traffic slice, gateway feature flag = v2-negotiation. No model/schema changes. Hold if client pins >1% or SDK heartbeat errors spike.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: roll-2024-09-3-v2. Window 00:30-02:30 UTC. Canary to 30% over 15m. Quarantine-on-error: enabled. Link: https://deploys.internal/roll-2024-09-3-v2

alice: Quick Q — do release notes need a compatibility callout for header case? any contract changes to mention to SDK teams?

ben: No contract changes. We added a header-negotiation flag (backwards compatible). Note in release notes: "API: v2 header negotiation opt-in; automatic fallback to v1 for 24h if mismatch." Ask SDK docs to note optional header and advise clients to add casefold handling.

jamie: Rollback criteria? what do oncall & SRE watch during canary?

ben: Agreed checklist: 
- Alert if error_rate(v2) > error_rate(v1) + 0.5% for 5m
- Alert if p50_latency increases >30% vs baseline for 5m
- If client_pin_ratio > 0.5% of total traffic, pause
- If deploy-bot quarantine triggers, do not progress
Manual rollback command:
```
deployctl rollback --deploy-id roll-2024-09-3-v2 --force-reason "canary-failure"
```

tilly: For SDK gating — if a tenant is pinned to v1, do we keep sticky routing? want to avoid evicting clients mid-session.

ben: Yes — sticky routing honored for 24h after rollforward. We will not evict active sessions. If a tenant is pinned in the header, we respect the pin and route to v1. Add that to operator handoff notes.

chun: Can deploy-bot do an automatic slow-down if error rate trends up but not enough to quarantine? e.g., pause progression and notify ops instead of full rollback.

ben: deploy-bot already supports "progression-threshold" flags — set to pause at 15% increments if error delta >0.25% and notify #oncall. I set progression-threshold=15% for this run.

deploy-bot: roll-2024-09-3-v2 scheduled with progression-threshold=15%, quarantine-on-error=true. Canary stage will emit metrics to telemetry.prod.redwood: v2.canary.*

jamie: OK - I'll add the alert queries to the dashboard and post links here before handoff. ping @tilly @chun when ready.

alice: I'll update the release notes and SDK doc blurb now.

ben: Thanks all — operator handoff at 00:25 UTC in #releases-handoff. If anyone sees anything odd during canary call it immediately. :thumbsup:

jamie: ack
